description: Shared shapes for the dev.antiphony.tenant.* methods: counts about the calling tenant's own posts. READ-TIME shapes, not records. Mirrors the Zod schemas in @antiphony/shared (types/stats.ts), which the lexicon-parity oracle holds to these definitions. Counts only: no per-author figure, no date-range parameter and no other tenant's number is part of this contract.

counts.description: How many posts, and how many of them are prompts and how many replies, over one set of rows. `posts` is always `prompts` plus `replies`.

posts.description: Every post in the set. Equal to `prompts` plus `replies`.

prompts.description: Posts that start a thread: those with no reply reference.

replies.description: Posts that answer another: those with a reply reference.

windows.description: Counts of the rows created within two fixed windows ending at the answer's `asOf`. A row is in a window when its creation time is at or after `asOf` minus the window's length. The windows are fixed: there is no way to ask for another.

last24h.description: Rows created in the 24 hours up to `asOf`.

last7d.description: Rows created in the 7 days up to `asOf`. Includes the 24 hour window.

postStats.description: Counts over one kind of post: every row, and the rows inside each window. All of its figures were counted in the same read.

totals.description: Every row the tenant has, whenever it was created.
